newsitem.title: JAPAN: Banks weak after morning decline.
newsitem.headline: Banks weak after morning decline.

text.p: Bank shares fell in the Monday trading session as anxieties over bad loans and the dissolving of cross share holdings continued to depress the sector, brokers said.
At 0346 GMT, Fuji Bank Ltd was down 90 yen at 1,380 yen and Sumitomo Bank Ltd was down 90 yen at 1,370 yen.

"Many participants believe that there is still room for the sector to fall," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said. "The atmosphere of the market is very bleak because if the sector falls further, it could bring down the whole market."
